interpretation: Observed trend authority improved removed-leader wealth versus the nonlinear parent but did not resolve joint risk and turnover deficiencies. All four declared candidates fail the unchanged necessary screen. No promotion or superiority claim.

issued_forecast_diagnosis.method: Use saved pre-2026 issued arrays and fully matured labels, not recomputed forecasts. Daily cross-sectional Spearman correlations have overlapping 60-session labels and are descriptive, not independent statistical observations.
issued_forecast_diagnosis.limitation: These descriptive pooled reliability bins include the explicit warm-up prior and overlapping paths; they do not establish significance or isolate model error from changing market regimes. They do show that another fixed risk threshold is not supported as a complete remedy.

validation: Hosted study completed successfully with 73 ordinary plus 14 research tests. All 188 manifest members and the complete source tree were independently verified after download; the published archive hash was read back from GitHub. Engineering success is not economic acceptance.
